description_en: Retrieves a list of file detection results from an archive
description_zh: 获取压缩包内文件检测结果列表
name: ListCompressFileDetectResult

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for the file
parameters.name: hash_key

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request, generated by Alibaba Cloud. Use this ID for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ResultList.description_en: A list of detection results for the files in the archive
ResultList.description_zh: 压缩包内文件检测结果列表

items.description_en: The details of a file detection result

Ext.description_en: Additional information about the detection result

HashKey.description_en: The unique identifier for the file

Path.description_en: The file path within the archive
Path.description_zh: 文件在压缩包内的路径

Result.description_en:
The detection result of the file. Valid values:

0: safe file

1: suspicious file

3: detection in progress
Result.description_zh:
文件检测结果。取值：

0：安全文件
1：可疑文件
3：检测中，请等待

Score.description_en:
The detection score for the file. The following list describes the score ranges and corresponding risk levels:

0–60: Safe

61–70: Risky

71–80: Suspicious

81–100: Malicious

<notice>

A higher score indicates a greater risk.

</notice>

This parameter is not returned when `Type` is `6`
Score.description_zh:
文件检测分数。分数区间及危险等级的对应关系如下：

0~60：安全
61~70：风险
71~80：可疑
81~100：恶意

<notice>分数越高，文件越可疑。></notice>

Type为6时不支持此参数
